change: Independent synthetic beam and ideal-column calculations, units, method limits and reproducible report artifacts are added. Nonzero transverse plate stress is rejected because its effect was previously omitted from the returned utilization.

The default sweep and registered example use supported axial and shear loads so output remains available. The beam moment sign definition and magnitude-only qualification are clarified; the public-method inventory is guarded against source changes.

Workflow reference hashes, test citations and retained demo outputs are aligned with supported loads. Unsupported CLI transverse stress gives an option error. Source bindings cover the calculation and dedicated evidence; shared presentation and registry files are referenced without byte bindings.
